# Upstream source

This directory preserves the runtime source of `github.com/hashicorp/yamux`
v0.1.2 under MPL-2.0 for distribution with the native core. The original
copyright and license are retained.

Complete upstream release: https://github.com/hashicorp/yamux/tree/v0.1.2

Test-only files, CI configuration, and test certificate/private-key fixtures
are omitted. They are not compiled into WGC NE. This copy is a corresponding
source/notice bundle, not a replacement Go module used by the build.
